sentences: This portrait is generally identified as Lisa Gherardini, wife of a Florentine merchant.
Leonardo never delivered it; he kept it with him for more than a decade, adding layers.
There are no hard outlines on the face.
Using sfumato, he built up dozens of ultra-thin glazes so that light and shadow blend like smoke.
The corners of her mouth and eyes are especially soft, so the smile seems to appear and disappear depending on where you look.
In the landscape behind her, the horizon on the left sits slightly lower than on the right, adding a quiet tension.
Its theft from the Louvre in 1911 turned it into the most famous painting in the world.
